text:
Congratulations on finding a job so quickly after getting your B1 visa! 🥳

So I would personally recommend Bank Leumi - they are the only Israeli bank to have an app in English, and they have a special branch in Tel Aviv especially for foreigners (in Gan HaIr/Ibn Gavirol). I was able to go there without an appointment and open an account, and they were extremely nice to me. You will need to bring two forms of ID, an also proof of your employment (i.e. a copy of your contract - but it can be digital) :) 

Leumi also gave me a credit card when I was on B1. But note that credit cards in Israel are different to many other countries, and this could be a source of confusion. Rather than giving you a line of credit where you can carry a balance from month-to-month and pay interest on it, Israeli credit cards function more like "delayed debit" cards: the full amount you spend is automatically debited from your bank account on a fixed date each month (with the popular option to split purchases into fixed installments, or tashlumim). There's generally no concept of carrying a revolving balance or making minimum payments here.
